rationale: While the terms do not actively disguise digital retail purchases as 'buying,' they employ a friendly, conversational tone to mask highly aggressive clauses regarding user content and privacy. The document grants Salesforce a perpetual, irrevocable license to user-submitted content while reserving the right to unilaterally terminate accounts, modify terms without notice, and share personal data with partners for marketing purposes.
